Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- Bone Align no longer guesses which way you should face: the Match facing option is gone, and Align only moves you into position, keeping your facing.
- New -90 / 180 / +90 turn buttons in Bone Align turn you around your chosen body part, so you can fix your facing in one click.
- Alignment memory now remembers your facing relative to your partner and exactly where the parts meet, so a remembered animation replays the way you set it, even if you turned yourself by hand.
- New Remember / Update memory button saves how you're placed right now without moving you, so tweaks you make after Align are kept.
